content:
Sometimes I realize that I'm not just a useless information source and I remember that I've done some pretty cool stuff! An exemple of that are the effects that I've done with [Adobe Photoshop](http://www.adobe.com/br/products/photoshop/ "Adobe Photoshop") + [Adobe Premiere](http://www.adobe.com/br/products/premiere/ "Site oficial"). One of them is a lightsaber fight that I've done with my friend Thiago (actually he did the bigger part of it, I just learned how to do it) and another one is a power effect just like [Kame Hame Ha](http://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kame_hame_ha "Kame Hame Ha no Wikipédia") . It's actually quite good, watch the two videos below:

`youtube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q6LpZMhu-L0`

`youtube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=psCb67mHjAk`

This one (just below) I made for a TV show called [Descarga MTV](http://twitter.com/descargamtv "Descarga MTV no Twitter")! It was on the show and everything, awesome, watch below:

`youtube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NWwKs6cV7-4`
